nodes.label: theme.js Rewritten to Read Tokens (hinge)
nodes.rationale: Same export names and shapes but values become var(--...), so all existing inline styles keep working and later phases can be incremental rather than a big-bang rewrite.

nodes.label: Admiralty visual direction
nodes.rationale: Replaced the warm Field Journal palette; section stale for a while, stranding manifest and alerts on old colours, hence tokens.css is the single source of truth.

nodes.label: Typography (Lora, Work Sans, IBM Plex Mono)
nodes.norm_label: typography (lora, work sans, ibm plex mono)

nodes.label: Field Journal design system
nodes.rationale: Spec snapshot as of Aug 2026; later replaced by Admiralty (BUILD-BRIEF §8).

nodes.label: ActionGrid / ActionList (unified hub pages)
nodes.rationale: kioskTheme.js stops being a parallel style system and becomes a size=kiosk variant, removing font-size mismatches between KeysHome and KeyStationMenu.

nodes.label: Control height token
nodes.rationale: 48px under coarse pointer gives kiosk/key-station touchscreens proper target size.

nodes.label: Kiosk size variant
nodes.rationale: Separate kioskTheme.js drifted to 20px radii/22px type; a shared scale prevents that.

nodes.label: Print exception to token rule
nodes.rationale: Renders into a separate document custom properties never reach.

nodes.label: Priority colour scale
nodes.rationale: Escalating scale deliberately not aliased to brand tokens; confirmed by Andy 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: Priority indicator bar
nodes.rationale: Solid rounded 6px bar preferred over earlier leaf-emoji icon badges; never reintroduce icons.

nodes.label: Seven-step type scale
nodes.rationale: App had 16 ad-hoc sizes before.

nodes.label: Empty-State Sweep
nodes.rationale: Each of ~42 sites judged individually; EmptyState's dashed box suits whole-section emptiness, so minor inline notes stayed plain text to avoid box-within-box. Actions added only where useful and never where they would abandon an in-progress form or dead-end unprivileged users.

nodes.label: Permission Matrix Sticky Column / Card View
nodes.norm_label: permission matrix sticky column / card view
nodes.rationale: Under 900px width query (not the phone check) the grid becomes one card per role, so half-width desktop windows also benefit.

nodes.label: Phase 2 - UI Primitives
nodes.rationale: One place per control with real interaction states; thin React wrappers, no new dependency or CSS-in-JS.

nodes.label: src/ui component library rule
nodes.rationale: Controls built from src/ui, not raw styled buttons or local fieldStyle.

nodes.label: forbid_role_delete_if_in_use
nodes.rationale: profiles.role_id is ON DELETE SET NULL and would silently orphan users.

nodes.label: report_equipment_fault
nodes.rationale: One narrow audited RPC so repair-job creation can't drift between callers; doesn't weaken equipment_update policy.

nodes.label: Equipment checkout concurrency
nodes.rationale: Partial unique index enforces one open checkout per unit; 23505 surfaced as friendly message.

nodes.label: Accept-Profile / Content-Profile Headers
nodes.rationale: Raw fetch() calls to PostgREST bypass supabase-js, so schema selection must be set per-request via headers (hub-send-notice-push and 5 calls in Hub App.jsx).

nodes.label: Auth Identity / UID Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Match by email, reuse existing UID or admin.createUser with email_confirm; remap in one transaction with deferred constraints. In execution done as load-order (non-auth tables first) instead of load-then-remap.

nodes.label: Cloud Session Egress Block to Supabase
nodes.norm_label: cloud session egress block to supabase

nodes.label: Direction Reversed - Hub and ParkMan2 Move Into Maintenance
nodes.norm_label: direction reversed - hub and parkman2 move into maintenance
nodes.rationale: Andy: Maintenance is by far the most live app (RFID kiosk, constant use), so it should never go through a migration; Hub is simple and ParkMan2 a low-traffic prototype, so moving them is lower-stakes despite more work.

nodes.label: Edge Function Name Prefixing
nodes.rationale: Function names share one namespace per project; send-notice-push collided, so the moving app's functions get an app prefix (parkman2-*, hub-*) to avoid future accidental collisions.

nodes.label: Freeze Window and Cutover
nodes.rationale: No in-app maintenance mode, so a short staff-communicated freeze; irreversible-feeling work done while old project still live, then full re-run not a diff.

nodes.label: Identity Sequence Advance After OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE
nodes.norm_label: identity sequence advance after overriding system value
nodes.rationale: Bulk-loading with OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE never advances the identity sequence, causing 23505 duplicate key; find all via information_schema.columns.is_identity and restart each sequence.

nodes.label: Nano/Free Compute Tier Slowdown
nodes.rationale: Trigger for the whole plan: slowdown was the smallest compute tier under load, fixable for $25/mo; prompted sharing one project and one bill across apps.

nodes.label: Option A - Join Shared Project in Own Schema
nodes.norm_label: option a - join shared project in own schema

nodes.label: Option B - Genuinely Shared Data Model
nodes.norm_label: option b - genuinely shared data model
nodes.rationale: A data model redesign (one canonical pitches table) rather than a relocation; deferred as follow-up once Option A is stable.

nodes.label: parkman2 Schema
nodes.rationale: Already fully parkman2.-qualified from day one, so replayed verbatim with zero substitution.

nodes.label: Schema-per-App Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each app in its own Postgres schema, exposed via pgrst.db_schemas; already proven in production by ParkMan2 and sidesteps table-name collisions like push_subscriptions.

nodes.label: Schema Relocation via public. Text Substitution
nodes.norm_label: schema relocation via public. text substitution
nodes.rationale: Safe for fully schema-qualified SQL; Hub's SQL relied on search_path, so it also needed search_path wrappers and schemaname string-literal fixes, otherwise idempotency checks become silently always-false.

nodes.label: Edge Function Secret Prefixing (VAPID)
nodes.rationale: Secrets are one flat namespace per project, so VAPID secrets for the moving app are prefixed (HUB_VAPID_*); RESEND_API_KEY shared unprefixed. VAPID pairs not consolidated because changing a pair breaks existing push subscriptions.

nodes.label: Storage Byte Copy via REST API
nodes.norm_label: storage byte copy via rest api
nodes.rationale: storage schema is project-scoped so bytes are not in a schema dump; upsert:true makes re-runs safe; bucket names kept to avoid editing call sites.

nodes.label: subscriptionMatchesCurrentKey()
nodes.rationale: Silently replaces stale subscriptions signed with the old public key, instead of relying on guests manually toggling notifications.

nodes.label: Hub VAPID Key Regeneration
nodes.rationale: Original values unrecoverable (dashboard shows only masked hashes); accepted trade-off of breaking 32 devices' push until resubscribed.

nodes.label: One-Week Rollback Safety Window
nodes.rationale: Deleting the old project is the only truly irreversible action; do not shorten under cost pressure.

nodes.label: delete_job
nodes.rationale: Only deletion path (no DELETE policy) keeps permission check in one place; storage objects removed by client.

nodes.label: enforce_checklist_item_photo_requirement
nodes.rationale: Separate permission from whole-job bypass because per-item safety requirement warrants explicit grant; visible override button rather than silent checkbox.

nodes.label: enforce_job_completion_photo_requirement
nodes.rationale: Hard per-job photo flag enforced server-side, distinct from soft job-type confirm.

nodes.label: forbid_job_activity_delete
nodes.rationale: job_activity is append-only except within delete_job's transaction flag.

nodes.label: jobs_sync_linked_parent
nodes.rationale: Done in DB so it happens however the job is closed, including offline.

nodes.label: Linked jobs
nodes.rationale: handoff/needed warn but never block (per Andy); parent_subtask_id has no FK to avoid PostgREST PGRST201 embed ambiguity.

nodes.label: Permission keys
nodes.rationale: Fixed growing list added via migrations, never a dynamic permission system.

nodes.label: Completion photo mechanisms
nodes.rationale: Three independent mechanisms: soft job-type confirm, hard per-job flag, per-checklist-item requirement.

nodes.label: Server-side business rules (triggers & RPCs)
nodes.rationale: Enforce column-change rules and atomic sequences RLS can't express.

nodes.label: Force-confirm invited email
nodes.rationale: signInWithOtp treats unconfirmed accounts as signups, rejected with signups disabled ('Signups not allowed'); root-caused via Zara.

nodes.label: Shared Supabase project ozhwgrzlpvfdemmogmav
nodes.rationale: Hub and ParkMan2 migrated into this project 28 Aug 2026, isolated by schema (hub, parkman2); this app uses public. Never write cross-schema queries.

nodes.label: Deleted project qkbpsqlrzygcairtidye
nodes.rationale: Deleted 7 Sep 2026; never point anything at it.

nodes.label: Suggested build order for a rebuild
nodes.norm_label: suggested build order for a rebuild

nodes.label: Explicit Data API table grants
nodes.rationale: Supabase stopped auto-granting on 30 Oct 2026; without grant the app gets permission denied. RLS still decides access.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph rules
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grep/source reads to get scoped subgraphs smaller than raw output; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Numbered idempotent SQL migration rule
nodes.rationale: Never edit an applied migration; add a new numbered file and run it against live project.

nodes.label: Offline foreground flush
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari lacks Background Sync API; flush on load/foreground and window.online.

nodes.label: Print components exception
nodes.rationale: Print renders into a separate document tokens never reach, so values are duplicated deliberately.

nodes.label: Regenerate package-lock.json on dependency change
nodes.rationale: Otherwise npm ci fails in CI.

nodes.label: Service role key never client-side
nodes.rationale: Service role bypasses RLS; must never reach the browser. Only VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY are client-side.

nodes.label: pg_cron + pg_net scheduling
nodes.rationale: Project has no Cron UI in the Dashboard; scheduling done via SQL.

nodes.label: Pro plan + Micro compute
nodes.rationale: Nano compute caused intermittent unresponsiveness 27-28 Aug 2026 (95% success rate); not a code/RLS bug, confirmed via pg_stat_activity. Pro+Micro $25/mo resolved it.

nodes.label: Resend custom SMTP for Auth
nodes.rationale: Supabase default 30 emails/hour auth limit can stall sign-in; recommended but not confirmed done.

nodes.label: Offline support
nodes.rationale: Plain insert not upsert on flush; unique violation on client_generated_id means already synced.

nodes.label: equipment_type_repair_assignees fallback
nodes.rationale: Org-wide not per-site; deliberately not built for multi-site yet.

nodes.label: inviteUserByEmail auth flow
nodes.rationale: Contractors and staff use the same invite flow; no separate contractor auth.

nodes.label: Reallocation
nodes.rationale: Cross-site_scope reallocation is open; don't hardcode an assumption.

nodes.label: site_scope
nodes.rationale: Single-scoped site means skip the site picker.

nodes.label: role_visibility pending confirmation
nodes.rationale: Beyond Head Gardener needs Andy's confirmation before building further.

nodes.label: Completion photo rule
nodes.rationale: Confirm dialog, not a hard block; skipped when someone completes on another's behalf.

nodes.label: Offline job creation
nodes.rationale: client_generated_id dedup; last-write-wins acceptable as rare edge case.

nodes.label: Row Level Security access control
nodes.rationale: Enforce all access at Postgres level; never rely on client-side filtering.

nodes.label: Multi-tenant data model
nodes.rationale: Built multi-tenant-ready from day one, but no multi-tenant UI beyond Tree Tops' needs.

nodes.label: Minimal Pre-paint Reset
nodes.rationale: Prevents a visibly wrong first frame before src/styles/base.css loads.

nodes.label: SPA Redirect Restore Script
nodes.rationale: Restores the originally-requested path via history.replaceState before React Router mounts so /kiosk or /jobs/:id deep links work.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages SPA 404 Fallback
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages has no server-side routing; encode requested path into ?redirect= and send to index.html.

nodes.label: Version bump on every push to main
nodes.norm_label: version bump on every push to main
nodes.rationale: Each push is a deploy; patch bump by default, minor only when Andy calls a release. Started at 1.1.0 on 24 Sep 2026.

nodes.label: Platform admin carve-out
nodes.rationale: Narrow per-table policies, not a blanket bypass.

nodes.label: Job visibility core rule
nodes.rationale: One predicate can_see_job reused by jobs and all child tables and job-photos storage policy.

nodes.label: Platform admin carve-out
nodes.rationale: Not a blanket bypass; each carve-out added individually. admin_access_log unwired until a second org.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: All access enforced in Postgres; usePermissions() is UI-only.

nodes.label: Phase 6 - Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Prevent drift recurring: UI rules in CLAUDE.md, an automated style check, and BUILD-BRIEF §8 as single source of visual truth (duplication is how the token layer drifted before).

nodes.label: ViewAsControl Dedicated-Class Fix
nodes.rationale: An inline style override on Button would permanently beat the CSS :hover rule, so a dedicated class pair in Layout.css was used instead.

nodes.label: Global :focus-visible Ring
nodes.rationale: Described as the single highest-value line in the plan; fixes both the not-sharp feel and an accessibility gap.

nodes.label: No Stylesheet Finding (1,425 inline styles)
nodes.rationale: Inline styles cannot express :hover/:focus, so the app had zero interaction states and no focus ring; fixing it requires a real stylesheet, reversing the deliberate no-CSS choice in useIsMobile.js.

nodes.label: Phase 1 - CSS Foundation and Token Layer
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 - css foundation and token layer

nodes.label: login_context claim
nodes.rationale: Pathname-only gate let kiosk sessions escape to desktop app; app_metadata claim is server-written and unspoofable; App.jsx signs out on mismatch rather than distinguish stale from live.

nodes.label: Admin Tabs as Real Routes (/admin/:tab)
nodes.rationale: activeTab was useState, so 20 admin screens could not be linked, bookmarked or refreshed and Back exited Admin; the biggest single usability problem.

nodes.label: Admiralty Navy Palette
nodes.rationale: D1: kept because it is what shipped and reads more professional; BUILD-BRIEF §8 updated to match instead of reverting code.

nodes.label: Mobile Bottom Tab Bar
nodes.rationale: D5: thumb-reachable, standard for a PWA, empties the cramped header; replaces NavMenu dropdown.

nodes.label: Palette Drift (Field Journal vs Admiralty)
nodes.rationale: theme.js moved to navy Admiralty palette but PWA manifest, index.html theme-color, modal overlays and warning panels kept the old warm colours, so the installed PWA splash/status bar mismatched the app.

nodes.label: Overdue Pill
nodes.community_name: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon
nodes.rationale: JobCard's 3px top border was easy to miss; replaced with a danger Pill while leaving the priority bar untouched.

nodes.label: Phase 5 - Polish
nodes.community_name: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon

nodes.label: Redesign Constraints (must not break)
nodes.community_name: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon

nodes.label: Print Output Keeps Literal Colours
nodes.community_name: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon
nodes.rationale: printJobCards renders into a separate window via renderToStaticMarkup; CSS custom properties on the app document never reach it, so print components keep resolved hex values (rawColors).

nodes.label: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon
nodes.community_name: Priority Is a Solid Colour Bar, Never an Icon
nodes.norm_label: priority is a solid colour bar, never an icon

nodes.label: Kiosk mode
nodes.rationale: 3-minute idle sign-out; no photo capability since photo-required templates aren't assigned to kiosk staff.

nodes.label: DND notification priority
nodes.rationale: safety_critical ignores DND; operational queues with delivered_at null until DND off.

nodes.label: Platform abstraction boundary
nodes.rationale: Isolate platform-specific capability behind stable signatures so internals can swap to Capacitor.

nodes.label: PWA first delivery
nodes.rationale: No Capacitor wrapper yet, but structure code so migration is a swap not a rewrite.

nodes.label: Shared filtered-jobs query
nodes.rationale: Dashboard, list and CSV export reuse one query to avoid divergent implementations.

nodes.label: Terminology lookup
nodes.rationale: Industry-varying strings come from terminology overrides merged over templates, never hardcoded.

nodes.label: Platform abstraction modules
nodes.rationale: Keeps a future Capacitor wrapper a swap, not a rewrite.

nodes.label: Edge Functions
nodes.rationale: Use service role key, so each re-implements its own authorization; explicit CORS headers since missing ones fail silently.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, control-h)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, control-h)
nodes.rationale: 7-step type scale and 4px spacing scale chosen to absorb existing ad-hoc values with minimal visual movement.

nodes.label: Px Tokenizing Sweep
nodes.rationale: Only tokenize a literal when a second identical use exists; values retained exactly (no rounding) since the app was only partially visually tested. Borders and one-offs deliberately left literal.

nodes.label: Touch Target Sizing (44px minimum)
nodes.rationale: Users tap in workshops/outdoors, often gloved; useIsMobile is a size check, not a pointer check, so wall-mounted touchscreens got 30px targets. Fixed via --control-h under @media (pointer: coarse).

nodes.label: Design token rule
nodes.rationale: All colour/size/spacing/radius from tokens.css or theme.js, never literals.

nodes.label: check-styles Changed-Files-Only Diffing
nodes.rationale: Diffs only files changed in the push (CHECK_STYLES_BASE = github.event.before) to catch new drift without failing on pre-existing code; needed fetch-depth: 0. Started non-blocking, flipped to blocking after clean pushes (8f); rgba added, literal px deferred because 199 hits would be landmines (8g).

nodes.label: GitHub Pages deploy pipeline
nodes.rationale: Confirmed live on jobs.treetops.co.uk; push to main builds and deploys automatically.

nodes.label: Passwordless auth
nodes.rationale: Magic link + 8-digit OTP; OTP path exists because installed iOS PWAs can't receive Mail links.

nodes.label: SPA fallback 404 redirect
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages has no server routing; 404.html redirects to ?redirect= and index.html restores path before router mounts.

nodes.label: CampManager to Sage Converter Tool
nodes.rationale: Runs entirely client-side; files never uploaded.

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Marker Convention
nodes.rationale: Marks deliberate simplifications with a known ceiling and upgrade path so they can be revisited.

nodes.label: Ponytail Audit Skill
nodes.rationale: ponytail-review applied repo-wide; ranked biggest cut first; correctness/security/perf out of scope.

nodes.label: no-trigger Rot Risk Tag
nodes.rationale: A ponytail: comment with no upgrade trigger silently rots; flagging it prevents 'later means never'.

nodes.label: Honesty Boundary (no per-repo savings numbers)
nodes.rationale: The unbuilt version was never written, so there is no baseline to subtract in a live repo; only /ponytail-debt gives real per-repo figures.

nodes.label: Leave the Calibration Knob (hardware)
nodes.rationale: Real hardware drifts; minimal models can't see physical tuning needs.

nodes.label: One Runnable Check Rule
nodes.rationale: Lazy code without its check is unfinished: non-trivial logic leaves one assert-based self-check or one small test.

nodes.label: Bug Fix = Root Cause, Not Symptom
nodes.norm_label: bug fix = root cause, not symptom
nodes.rationale: One guard in the shared function is a smaller diff than a guard in every caller; patching only the named path leaves sibling callers broken.

nodes.label: The Ladder (YAGNI -> reuse -> stdlib -> native -> dep -> one line -> minimum)
nodes.norm_label: the ladder (yagni -> reuse -> stdlib -> native -> dep -> one line -> minimum)
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first rung that holds; runs after understanding the problem, not instead of it.

nodes.label: When NOT to Be Lazy
nodes.rationale: Never simplify away input validation at trust boundaries, data-loss error handling, security, accessibility, or explicit requests; never be lazy about understanding the problem.

nodes.label: ==CORE== Pure Logic Block (shared with tests)
nodes.rationale: Pure logic with no DOM, delimited so the test script can load it.

nodes.label: src/components/KeyReasonsModal.jsx
nodes.rationale: Generalised from ContractorReasonsModal once a second near-identical use appeared.
